_about: Pictures for the deep-time periods and events, keyed period-<id> and event-<id>; each key a list in the order the More shows them, an empty list where the answer is none. A picture with "held" waits on Michael and is not shown (none at present). Captions may hold <i> for names in italics. Written by Claude from claude/Pictures-Deep-01.md (checked 12 Oct 2026, read by Michael 13 Oct); edit the batch file, not this.

period-recovery.caption: A copy of one bone from the backbone of Titanoboa, whose bones were found in the coal mine at Cerrejón, in the Museo Geológico Nacional José Royo y Gómez in Bogotá.
